title: Concept: Server-side fetch of assembled URL (julia) — review required
description: In julia, HTTP.get(base * p) requests a URL assembled from runtime values, so a caller can point the server at internal addresses or metadata services. The remedy is a fixed host or a strict allowlist (a host allowlist).
applicability: julia server code; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Internal access via metadata and intranet; HIGH severity.
